```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = "\\s*,\\s*")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Films with a score:", sum(!is.na(movies$tomatoMeter))),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  movies_summary,
  aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap, .desc = TRUE))
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics",
    x = "Mean gap (Tomatometer - audience score)",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(
    actor = case_when(
      title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
      title %in% c("The Amazing Spider-Man", "The Amazing Spider-Man 2") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
      title %in% c(
        "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
        "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
        "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
      ) ~ "Tom Holland"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  arrange(desc(gap)) |>
  select(title, actor, gap)
```
